checks.name: Official native ROOT tree and HepMC identity
checks.method: Read 128 native ROOT entries, require two status-1 opposite-sign muons per event, compare exact pinned HepMC vectors and native reco TRefs.

checks.name: Central reco directions preserved
checks.method: Independently compute truth eta and wrapped phi from HepMC vectors.

checks.name: Central muon efficiency card response
checks.method: Fixed central selection and 0.99 x 0.95 target, binomial standard error.

checks.name: Independent central pT smearing distribution
checks.method: Derive standardized log-pT behavior from source log-normal transform and stock central resolution; require RMS [0.65,1.35] and absolute mean <= 5 SE.

checks.name: Separate seeded physics content replay
checks.observed: Exact matched truth+reco event values and metrics
checks.method: Independently rerun native Delphes and compare ordered logical payload SHA and summary; ROOT file metadata allowed to differ.

checks.name: Incorrect source identity is rejected
checks.method: Append a byte to parent HepMC; script rejects it by SHA before opening ROOT.
